freeze_recommendation.reason: The draft design is sound, but cache semantics, qualification enforcement, exact parity scope, workload-manifest completeness, and provenance/normalization instrumentation are not yet aligned between contract, schema, and runner.

strengths: Frozen B1-B3 repository matrix and commit pins
Fresh output paths and child-process execution for measured build/query units
Raw repetition retention with recomputable derived aggregates
Incremental result compared with a fresh full rebuild rather than approximate counts
Frozen query and mutation input concept
Concurrent queries and external baselines appropriately deferred

findings.finding: New process and fresh DB/output are reproducible; OS filesystem/page-cache state is not cleared or measured. A/B do not retain application or database cache across child processes.
findings.minimum_change: Use explicit fresh-output/new-process and OS-page-cache-uncontrolled labels; record cache policy, platform, privilege, and whether eviction was attempted. Do not call a new process filesystem-cold.

findings.finding: Unique temporary DB paths are used, but effective parser/resolver/thread configuration and preexisting-output assertions are not captured as frozen input identity.
findings.minimum_change: Record canonical effective configuration or hashes and assert output/DB absence before each full-build rep.

findings.finding: PeakWorkingSetSize/RUSAGE_SELF and process_time measure the main child only, not parser descendants or total system consumption.
findings.minimum_change: Either add process-tree accounting or label CPU/RSS explicitly as main-measured-child-only on each platform.

findings.finding: The runner uses limited custom validation instead of the stated JSON Schema, and the schema permits raw reps without workload-specific measurement fields.
findings.minimum_change: Validate against the frozen schema and enforce workload-specific raw/derived, incremental, parity, and query evidence fields.

findings.finding: A warm-up is currently labelled measured; CLI permits reps below the contract minima; repository/workload/cache/mutation ordering is not frozen; n=5 P95 and small-n P99 lack descriptive-only limits.
findings.minimum_change: Exclude A warm-up, reject undersized qualification runs, freeze schedule/order, retain all samples, and label percentile tails descriptive with their sample counts.

findings.finding: M1/M2/M3 cover local body edit, symbol addition in an existing file, and file deletion, but omit cross-file interface invalidation and are biased toward easy/local cases.
findings.minimum_change: Add one frozen public declaration/signature plus required call-site update family. Keep rename/move, overlay, and high-fanout stress deferred rather than expanding V1 broadly.

findings.finding: Only aria2 has a mutation manifest, while C is required for B1-B3.
findings.minimum_change: Freeze B2 and B3 mutation manifests before formal three-repository qualification.

findings.finding: The gated digests cover useful node/edge facts but raw-reference facts omit source identity/candidates, shard state is omitted, API/query-visible state is omitted, and strict mismatch is diagnostic only.
findings.minimum_change: Expand canonical parity digests to the documented state or narrow the documented parity claim; define strict-mismatch disposition. Keep exact incremental-versus-fresh-full parity, with ±10% drift only as anomaly detection.

findings.finding: The current field equals incremental command wall time and does not verify that a query observes the mutation.
findings.minimum_change: Rename to incremental_command_latency_ms or add a measured post-update query-visibility probe before using time_to_freshness_ms.

findings.finding: Child timing excludes copy/mutation/parity overhead, but the contract does not separately record harness/validation overhead or provide component timing sufficient for causal claims about incremental > full.
findings.minimum_change: Record system-under-test latency separately from harness/validation overhead; prohibit causal attribution from smoke data.

findings.finding: The aria2 20-query set covers symbol/caller/callee/subgraph, but B2/B3 manifests are absent, source_database is machine-local, manifest anchor identity is not verified, and query order is not frozen beyond file order.
findings.minimum_change: Freeze B2/B3 manifests, make provenance portable, validate qualified anchors, freeze/record ordering, and report descriptive percentiles with per-type sample counts.

findings.finding: The contract requires non-LOC cost denominators, but the runner outputs only per-KLOC costs plus edges/node; sec/1K symbols, MiB/1K symbols, DB bytes/node or reference, and a defined symbol denominator are absent.
findings.minimum_change: Add the promised per-symbol/per-node and DB-per-node/reference fields and preserve their raw denominators. Do not infer a single LOC slope.

findings.finding: The runner omits cores, RAM, filesystem/storage, thread configuration, compiler/tool versions, effective configuration hashes, and an operator-supplied load note required by the contract.
findings.minimum_change: Capture these fields or use explicit unknown; require a formal-run load note and do not guess unavailable values.

findings.finding: The raw-system-cost framework is appropriate and external baseline comparison is deferred.
findings.minimum_change: Retain raw distributions; do not claim agent-token or comparative total-cost savings in V1.

findings.finding: Concurrency level, worker model, shared-cache semantics, errors/timeouts, and latency/throughput instrumentation are not frozen.
V1 ends at RocksDB's 622,772 C/C++ LOC and has no same-machine external baseline.
findings.minimum_change: Keep B4/B5, million/10M claims, and cross-system claims deferred.

deferred_scope: B4 >=1M LOC, B5 multi-million, and ~11M LOC claims
Causal explanation of aria2 incremental smoke anomaly
